title: FBI Photo B020
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or sensor display with a central crosshair reticle formed by vertical and horizontal lines bearing tick marks. The horizontal scale is numbered 15, 10, 5 to the left of center and 5, 10, 15 to the right, suggesting a measurement graticule. A solid black bar fills the top of the frame. Six rectangular black redaction-like bars are arranged in three rows down the left and right sides of the image, some with lighter gray edges. Near the center-right, slightly above the horizontal axis, is a small dark blurred blob. A white timestamp appears in the lower-left corner. The background has visible noise/speckle texture.

observations.claim: A crosshair reticle with tick marks is centered in the image
A horizontal scale is numbered 15, 10, 5 on both sides of center
A white timestamp reads 12/31/99 18:18:58 in the lower-left corner
Six black rectangular bars are arranged along the left and right sides
A solid black band occupies the top of the frame
A small dark blurred blob appears near the center-right above the horizontal axis
The background has grainy noise texture typical of a video sensor

pages.reticle_style: large full-frame crosshair with white tick marks

tracked_object.shape: small dark elongated shape (similar to B019)

zhang_disagreements.our_text: scale is '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' — same as early burst-2 frames. Scale change to '3' happens at B022 (18:19:19), not B019/B020.
